title: lisianthius perkinsiae
intro: Lisianthius perkinsiae, commonly known as the Lisianthus plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Lisianthus perkinsiae include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
